probe_registry.comment: Binds the bespoke probe labels of the cases to the cargo test targets that implement them. The key is the label without its parentheses (crash-recovery-kill-9); the value names the cargo package, the cargo test target and the filter that selects the probe's test. A label with no binding has not been migrated into the baseline: the adapter reports such a case NOT_RUN and names the gap. Binding a label is an owner decision.
